rationale: Reallocated fp16 export budget around the winning reverse-tail recurrent path: reduced generic tail projection rescue from two blocks to one and rescued `attn.c_v.weight` across both recurrent tail blocks. This keeps the staged recurrence curriculum intact while shifting bytes toward value-path tensors that are more likely to survive final int8+zlib roundtrip sensitivity on the active tail.
title: Recurrent-Tail V Rescue Reallocation
